INTeo DATE
DEPT 23, 2026

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION i. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House)

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No 1-J in the area bounded by

A line 208.05 feet north of and parallel to West Huron Avenue;
North St. louis Avenue; a line 169.6 feet north of and parallel to
West Huron Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to
North St. Louis Avenue,

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of property: 718 North St. Louis Avenue
